description.value: barBURRITO is part of Canada's largest burrito chain, operating since 2005, with over 385 locations nationwide. The Sidney location serves fully customizable Mexican-inspired meals — burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas — assembled to order from fresh, in-house ingredients. Cyclists will find a quick, filling stop with a broad menu that includes vegetarian proteins and gluten-free tortilla options.

address.value: 10330 McDonald Park Road, Sidney, BC V8L2L5
